evidence: Cic. Off. 1.130: color exercitātiōnibus corporis (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Cicero’s phrase for bodily exercise; as a school subject, the plural exercitātiōnēs corporis serves as well.

evidence: Plaut. Most. 1.2.72 (Lewis & Short, a line it calls spurious)
terms.comment: Traupman’s word for gymnastics; gymnasticus is Plautine (Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: exercitatio · Lewis & Short: gymnasticus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 64.
